text:
oliver: Shadow rollout update: we put model v2025-3b-int8-shadow on 2% shadow traffic for summarization last hour. seeing consistent multi-turn rouge-l drop ~3.5 points on our convo eval set :thinking_face:
maria: can you paste the sentinel eval config you used?
oliver: sure — short snippet: ```sentinels: - name: convo_50 - window: 5m - metric: rouge_l - threshold: -2.0 - action: cut_to_candidate_if_breached```
raj: 3.5 is higher than i'd expect for int8. is this on raw shadow traffic or post-filtered?
eva: it's raw shadow, no post-filtering. i replayed ~1.2k samples through the shadow vs prod pair. distribution skew toward longer contexts today tho. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maria: length skew could amplify quant noise. can we check per-length bucket deltas?
oliver: yes — quick buckets: 0-128: -0.8, 129-512: -2.1, 513-2048: -6.4. biggest pain at >512 tokens.
sre-oncall: @oliver if we cut traffic do we have an automatic fallback path? what is the recovery behavior?
oliver: current idea: add a 'chokepoint' gate in the router that watches sentinel windows. rule: if rolling_eval.metric_delta <= -3.0 over 5m OR per-request logprob_delta >= 0.75 (avg topk), then stop routing to new variant and flip to pinned stable model. also alert slack channel and trigger canary rollback job.
maria: per-request logprob_delta is noisy, maybe require both conditions OR yesterday's baseline drifts to be small. i suggest composite rule: (rouge_drop > threshold AND p95_latency < latency_cap) OR (logprob_delta > big_threshold AND spike_in_nll_count > X).
raj: agree with composite. also add a short cool-down window so we don't thrash on bursty data. 2x samples or 10m cooldown?
eva: can we use a 'grace' mode where we route 100% of a tiny shadow subset (0.2%) to watch immediate rollback signals before cutting live? less noisy than full 2%
oliver: good call. propose updated policy: - phase A: shadow 2% continuous + sentinel eval - phase B: if sentinel breach, enable grace 0.2% live routing for 10m with stricter sentinels - phase C: if grace breach, cut to zero and swap to last-stable, create incident ticket.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: add-router-gate(chokepoint,policy=v2) — CI passed. starting rollout pipeline.
sre-oncall: make sure router metrics expose "active_chokepoint_count" and we log event with request ids for postmortem traceability.
maria: one more: add targeted sentinel prompts (hallucination checks + safety paraphrase set) — that will catch qualitative regressions not captured by rouge.
raj: can we add per-customer tolerance? enterprise tenants may need stricter gates. config should be per-tenant overrideable.
oliver: yep — policy schema will include tenant_overrides and severity weighting. i'll open a PR with schema + rollout plan. kicking off a small replay job to validate thresholds.
eva: if you need quick eval datasets i have the long-context convo bank (cc: @oliver).
oliver: thanks! i'll tag you in the PR. planning to enable grace mode for a few hours tomorrow morning during low traffic window. :thumbsup:
